hero.title: Your hardest years should count, whatever the result.
hero.sub: Graduates preparing for an examination teach one class a day in Chamba. In return: a reserved library desk, certified teaching hours, access to Corteon for your own preparation, and a place to stay on if you do well.
hero.strip: Behind the Post Office, Chamba · Applications Open · 1 class a day

theDeal.label: THE DEAL
theDeal.title: Colleagues, not cheap labour.
theDeal.lead: A transparent agreement between Synapse and every fellow. What you give and what you receive are explicit from day one.

give.heading: What you give
give.summary: Focused teaching commitment with zero administrative burden.
items: One class a day: teach exactly one class per day. Nothing else (no hidden minutes, no collaboration hours).
Small groups: work with a small group of learners with pedagogical patience.
Subject mastery: guide students through core concepts, daily practice tests, and doubt clinics.

receive.heading: What you receive
receive.summary: Quiet space, recognized hours, and tools for your own goals.
items: Free reserved library desk: a dedicated quiet study desk in the building for your own preparation.
Certified teaching hours: verified certificate of teaching hours and pedagogical practice.
Access to Corteon: full access to our tutor and practice engine for your own examination preparation.
A place to stay on if you do well: clear opportunity to continue as a senior fellow or centre guide.

theDeal.note: Fellow load is strictly one class a day. Terms not published or settled here are to be agreed.

ladder.label: PEDAGOGICAL LADDER
ladder.title: A progression built on pedagogical practice.
ladder.lead: Teaching at Synapse is structured into clear stages. Only what is live today is described in the present tense; others use planned or direction.

stages.name: Teaching Fellow
stages.role: Graduates preparing for an examination who teach one class a day.
benefits: Free reserved library desk in the building
Access to Corteon for own preparation
A place to stay on if you do well
stages.compensation: Free reserved desk and tools. Other terms to be agreed.

stages.name: Senior Pedagogical Fellow
stages.role: Leads a pod, records lessons, and guides newer fellows.
stages.load: One class a day and lesson curation
stages.compensation: Stipend and a share of media revenue: amount to be agreed.

stages.name: Centre Guide & Faculty
stages.role: A place to stay on if you do well, or after your examination.

selection.label: SELECTION PROCESS
selection.title: Children deserve good teachers, so we take care.
selection.lead: Selection focuses on pedagogical patience, subject mastery, and communication. We look for graduates who respect learners and value deep foundational understanding.

steps.name: Application & Review
steps.summary: Tell us about your subject background and the exam you are preparing for.
steps.focus: We review your academic background, subject clarity, and motivation to teach in Chamba.

steps.name: Personal Interview
steps.summary: A conversation with the centre guide on study rhythms and pedagogical patience.
steps.focus: We discuss how you balance your own exam preparation with classroom commitment.

steps.name: Teaching Simulation
steps.summary: Explain a foundational concept to a small group using hints before answers.
steps.focus: We observe your patience, clarity, and how you respond to student doubts.

selection.closingNote: No exam rank cutoffs or artificial selection barriers. The owner phones back personally within 24 hours.
